titleStmt.title: Repeated microinjections into the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) impair extinction of conditioned place preference in mice
titleStmt.author: Groblewski
Cunningham

publicationStmt.p: Tag layer of the DHSS Meta-Tagging Project. The article text is reproduced from the staged copy named in sourceDesc and is not altered; the tags are held separately in standOff so that overlapping and nested spans are preserved.

bibl.title: Repeated microinjections into the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) impair extinction of conditioned place preference in mice

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: The intra-mPFC microinjection procedure itself, and whether repeating it is compatible with studying extinction learning.
span.quote: We examined the effects of intra-mPFC inactivation (with bupivacaine) on extinction of ethanol-induced CPP in mice.

span.label: null-result
span.quote: Thus, neither the control (Vehicle) nor the experimental group (Bupivacaine) showed significant extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: extinction of ethanol-induced conditioned place preference
span.quote: The medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) is important for extinction of many behaviors including conditioned place preference (CPP).

span.label: behavioural-experiment
span.quote: We examined the effects of intra-mPFC inactivation (with bupivacaine) on extinction of ethanol-induced CPP in mice.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: repeated cannula and injector insertion destroys tissue in Layers I-III of the mPFC on both sides of the midline, removing projection neurons that normally regulate the nucleus accumbens and basolateral amygdala, and the loss of that top-down regulation is what blocks extinction learning
span.quote: Therefore, it is conceivable that the damage caused by the microinjection procedure resulted in altered mPFC regulation of the NAc and BLC, thereby impairing extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: cumulative mechanical damage from implantation plus repeated infusions amounts to a partial lesion of a region already shown to be necessary for extinction, so the injection itself reproduces the lesion effect regardless of what is infused
span.quote: The most parsimonious explanation for these findings is that the microinjection procedure, regardless of the compound being injected, caused tissue damage to an area of the brain shown to be necessary for extinction of EtOH-CPP [ 1 ].

span.label: The vehicle group could not serve as the control, because whatever impaired extinction affected vehicle and drug alike
span.quote: Because of the incomplete extinction in the Vehicle group, it remained unknown if inactivation of the mPFC with bupivacaine was able to impair extinction.

span.label: Only a group that never had the procedure could reveal it, which is why the no-surgery control was added in the second experiment
span.quote: Finally, an additional control group that did not receive surgery was included (No Sx group) in order to assess the effects of the handling portion of the microinjection procedure on extinction learning.

span.label: The proposed cause: the repeated procedure damages the very region it is delivering into, amounting to a partial lesion
span.quote: The most parsimonious explanation for these findings is that the microinjection procedure, regardless of the compound being injected, caused tissue damage to an area of the brain shown to be necessary for extinction of EtOH-CPP [ 1 ].

span.label: Because the cannula sat on the midline, the damage was bilateral rather than confined to one hemisphere
span.quote: Importantly, because these cannulae were located on the sagital midline, tissue damage to these layers of the cortex affected both hemispheres.

span.label: The damaged layers contain projection neurons to accumbens and amygdala whose activity changes with drug cues, which is a route from local damage to the behavioural failure
span.quote: Retrograde tracing experiments have shown that Layers II/III of the mPFC contain dense populations of projection neurons that terminate in both the nucleus accumbens (NAc) and basolateral amygdala complex (BLC) [ 13 , 14 ].

span.label: Surgery and anaesthesia were ruled out by comparison with their own earlier study matched on strain, frame, coordinates, anaesthesia and surgeon
span.quote: Importantly, the current surgeries and those described by Groblewski et al. (2011) used the same strain of mice (male, DBA/2J mice), stereotaxic frame and coordinates, anesthesia (type, concentration, and duration of exposure), and were all performed by the same surgeon.

span.label: The planned within-subject comparisons were run regardless of the interaction and are acknowledged as not statistically justified.
span.quote: This method of analysis, although not statistically justified, was implemented because of the narrow detection window and increased variability that are inherent to our extinction procedure (e.g., [ 1 , 8 ]).

span.label: The proposed explanation via damage to mPFC projection neurons is untested and needs confirmation.
span.quote: Of course, further examination of the effects of the microinjection procedure on these specific projections within the mPFC, as well as their projection targets, is required to confirm this suggestion.

span.label: As performed, the microinjection procedure cannot be used to test intra-mPFC pharmacological manipulations of EtOH-CPP extinction.
span.quote: It is important to note that irrespective of how each component of the microinjection procedure contributes to the observed effect, as currently performed, this procedure is not adequately suited to examine the effects of intra-mPFC pharmacological manipulations on extinction of EtOH-CPP in mice.

span.label: The authors state that their own analysis is not statistically justified, and say why they used it anyway
span.quote: This method of analysis, although not statistically justified, was implemented because of the narrow detection window and increased variability that are inherent to our extinction procedure (e.g., [ 1 , 8 ]).

span.label: Animals were removed for failing to acquire a preference and for histology, about a third of each experiment
span.quote: In Experiment 1, a total of 18 animals were removed from analysis (9 showed less than 50% preference on Test 1 and an additional 9 were removed for not meeting histological criteria).

span.label: Non-learners were excluded by an a priori rule, which is disclosed and defended by reference to prior practice
span.quote: Because the goal of these experiments was to specifically manipulate extinction of an acquired EtOH-CPP, we decided, a priori , to remove animals that failed to express a place preference of greater than 50% on Test 1.

span.label: The strongest extra evidence - doubling extinction to six days - is reported as data not shown
span.quote: In fact, in one of the replicates of Experiment 1 we extended extinction by an additional 3 days (for a total of 6 days). Despite doubling the number of extinction trials, we found that both mPFC-injected groups continued to exhibit impaired extinction—that is, both groups showed persistent CPP (data not shown).

span.label: The damage-to-projection account is offered as conceivable and explicitly not established
span.quote: Of course, further examination of the effects of the microinjection procedure on these specific projections within the mPFC, as well as their projection targets, is required to confirm this suggestion.

span.label: No group-by-test interaction reached significance in either experiment, so the key contrast rests on the planned within-group comparisons
span.quote: Specifically, the initial 2-way ANOVA revealed a main effect of Test [ F (1,40) = 9.3, p < .005] but not Group, and no significant Group × Test interaction ( p's > .05).

span.label: an additional group given NO SURGERY AT ALL (the No Sx group), alongside the vehicle-infused and drug-infused groups
span.quote: Finally, an additional control group that did not receive surgery was included (No Sx group) in order to assess the effects of the handling portion of the microinjection procedure on extinction learning.

span.label: control - VEHICLE: everything but the drug, which is the standard control and here shares the confound
span.quote: In the PM sessions, animals received a microinjection of vehicle (saline) or bupivacaine (bupivacaine hydrochloride (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) in isotonic saline at 2% w/v or 20 mg/ml) followed by an IP saline injection and immediate placement onto the CS+ floor for 30 min.

span.label: control - NO PROCEDURE AT ALL: no surgery, no cannula, no injection, and the only group in which extinction occurred
span.quote: These data suggest that the No Sx, but not Vehicle or Bupivacaine, group significantly extinguished.

span.label: the manipulation - as intended: reversible pharmacological inactivation of a region during extinction trials
span.quote: We hypothesized that intra-mPFC injection of bupivacaine prior to each of the extinction trials would prevent mPFC function thereby blocking extinction of CPP.

span.label: the manipulation - as delivered: cumulative mechanical damage from repeating the delivery, which is a lesion and not an inactivation
span.quote: The tissue damage that resulted from the multiple microinjections in Experiments 1 and 2 may have been sufficient to effectively result in a partial or complete lesion of portions of the mPFC.

span.label: extinction procedure - single-session, as in conditioned fear, where one injection suffices and this problem never arises
span.quote: Most studies examining the effects of intra-mPFC pharmacological manipulations on extinction have involved conditioned fear procedures that require only a single injection prior to, or following, a single extinction session (e.g., [ 16 ]).

span.label: extinction procedure - multi-day, as required for ethanol place preference, where the injections must be repeated and the damage accumulates
span.quote: Unlike extinction of conditioned fear, however, extinction of EtOH-CPP requires multiple extinction trials over the course of several days.

span.label: extends → Groblewski et al. mPFC lesion findings [1] and the rat bupivacaine microinjection procedure [2]
span.quote: In order to expand upon the lesion results we recently attempted to determine the effects of reversible mPFC inactivation on extinction of EtOH-CPP in mice via microinjections of bupivacaine (similar to a previous procedure used in rats [ 2 ]).

span.label: builds-on → Groblewski et al. (2011) [1] electrode-insertion control result
span.quote: It is unlikely that the observed effect was a direct result of the surgery/anesthesia per se as we have previously shown that a one-time insertion of an electrode into the same area of the mPFC while under general anesthesia did not impair subsequent extinction [ 1 ].

span.label: extends → Groblewski et al. on mPFC lesions impairing extinction of ethanol place preference
span.quote: Additionally, Groblewski et al. then showed that electrolytic lesions of the mPFC following conditioning significantly impaired extinction of EtOH-induced conditioned place preference (CPP) in mice—a finding that is in agreement with previous reports implicating the mPFC in extinction of CPP [ 2 , 3 ].

span.label: critiques → the repeated intra-mPFC microinjection procedure as a tool for multi-day extinction studies
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS THE NUMBER OF INJECTIONS, AND MINIMISING IT DOES NOT HELP. 'the damage caused by intra-mPFC injections EVEN WHEN THE NUMBER OF INJECTIONS WAS MINIMIZED, was sufficient enough to impair extinction - an effect that PERSISTED DESPITE EXTENDED EXTINCTION TRAINING.' The critique of the procedure is dosed: it survives the obvious remedy. Q-444.
span.quote: These findings suggest that the damage caused by intra-mPFC injections even when the number of injections was minimized, was sufficient enough to impair extinction—an effect that persisted despite extended extinction training.

span.label: microinjection —causes→ lesion
span.quote: The tissue damage that resulted from the multiple microinjections in Experiments 1 and 2 may have been sufficient to effectively result in a partial or complete lesion of portions of the mPFC.

span.label: microinjection —causes→ extinction
span.quote: Together, these experiments suggest some component of the microinjection procedure (but not merely the handling required to make the injections) interfered with extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: medial prefrontal cortex —causes→ extinction
span.quote: The medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) is important for extinction of many behaviors including conditioned place preference (CPP).

span.label: RETRACTED (RE-GROUNDED) · vehicle —contrasted-with→ No Sx
span.note: RETRACTED: RE-GROUNDED. The old span named only the No Sx group. This sentence names both and carries the contrast with its direction - 'the No Sx, BUT NOT Vehicle or Bupivacaine, group significantly extinguished'. — strength of the relation: 1
span.quote: Analysis of the place preference from Tests 1 and 2 of Experiment 2 revealed that only the No Sx group exhibited significant extinction ( Figure 2B ).

span.label: bupivacaine —operationalised-as→ medial prefrontal cortex
span.quote: Similar to lidocaine, bupivacaine is a sodium channel blocker that, when injected, temporarily inactivates neuronal signaling by preventing membrane depolarization and subsequent action potentials [ 4 ].

span.label: prelimbic —part-of→ medial prefrontal cortex
span.quote: Specifically, Groblewski et al. showed that the prelimbic (PL) and infralimbic (IL) subregions of the mPFC exhibited significant activation of cAMP response element-binding (CREB) protein following a brief exposure to a cue that had previously been paired with ethanol.

span.label: infralimbic —part-of→ medial prefrontal cortex
span.quote: Specifically, Groblewski et al. showed that the prelimbic (PL) and infralimbic (IL) subregions of the mPFC exhibited significant activation of cAMP response element-binding (CREB) protein following a brief exposure to a cue that had previously been paired with ethanol.

span.label: guide cannula —part-of→ microinjection
span.quote: An indwelling, stainless steel guide cannula (10 mm, 28g) was implanted, aimed 1 mm dorsal to the target area in the mPFC (AP: +1.8 mm, ML: 0.0 mm, DV: −2.5 mm) using a mouse brain atlas [ 7 ].

span.label: nucleus accumbens —part-of→ medial prefrontal cortex
span.quote: Retrograde tracing experiments have shown that Layers II/III of the mPFC contain dense populations of projection neurons that terminate in both the nucleus accumbens (NAc) and basolateral amygdala complex (BLC) [ 13 , 14 ].

span.label: conditioned place preference —operationalised-as→ conditioned stimuli
span.quote: The conditioned stimuli (CSs) consisted of two distinct tactile cues—grid and hole floors.

span.label: conditioned fear —contrasted-with→ conditioned place preference
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS HOW MUCH TRAINING EXTINCTION TAKES. 'UNLIKE EXTINCTION OF CONDITIONED FEAR, however, EXTINCTION OF ETOH-CPP REQUIRES MULTIPLE EXTINCTION TRIALS OVER THE COURSE OF SEVERAL DAYS.' Both are extinction; they differ on the schedule needed, which is why a procedure validated on one can fail on the other for reasons that have nothing to do with the mechanism. Q-467. · strength of the relation: 1
span.quote: Unlike extinction of conditioned fear, however, extinction of EtOH-CPP requires multiple extinction trials over the course of several days.

span.label: histological criteria —operationalised-as→ guide cannula
span.quote: Histological analysis revealed that the injector tracks terminated at a point within the target region between the PL and IL subregions of the mPFC and there was no difference in the location of injector tips for the two groups ( Figure 1 ).

span.label: vehicle —contrasted-with→ No Sx
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHETHER THE GROUP EXTINGUISHED AT ALL, AND THE VEHICLE CONTROL FAILS WITH THE DRUG. 'These data suggest that THE NO SX, BUT NOT VEHICLE OR BUPIVACAINE, GROUP SIGNIFICANTLY EXTINGUISHED.' The vehicle group is supposed to be the drug-free comparison; IT BEHAVES LIKE THE DRUG GROUP, so the axis separates surgery-free animals from injected ones rather than drug from vehicle. The control failing with the treatment is the paper's finding. Q-472. · strength of the relation: 1 — RE-GROUNDS Groblewski2012-repeated-microinjections-into-the-medial-pre[3]: the old span named ONE endpoint.
span.quote: These data suggest that the No Sx, but not Vehicle or Bupivacaine, group significantly extinguished.

span.label: ANOVA
span.quote: place preference was assessed using analysis of variance (ANOVA) of the percentage of each test spent on the EtOH-paired (CS+) floor (% Time on EtOH-paired floor)

span.label: two-way ANOVA with interaction term
span.quote: Specifically, the 2-way ANOVA of the Percent Time Spent on the EtOH-paired floor revealed a main effect of Test [ F (1,33) = 4.3, p < .05] but no main effect of Group or a Group × Test interaction ( p's > .05).

span.label: paired t-test
span.quote: The results of the separate paired t-tests showed a significant decrease in preference for only the No Sx group [ t (11) = 2.5 p < .05].

span.label: Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons
span.quote: Extinction was defined a priori as a significant reduction in place preference that was determined by Bonferroni-adjusted within-subjects comparisons of preferences on Test 1 and 2 (paired t-tests) for each group following an initial 2-way ANOVA (Group × Test) and were performed whether or not the interaction was significant.

span.label: alpha level / significance threshold
span.quote: Overall α was set at .05 for all statistical tests.

span.label: standard error of the mean
span.quote: Data are expressed as mean (± SEM).

span.label: Neither the bupivacaine group nor its vehicle-injected control extinguished ethanol place preference, so the intended pharmacological comparison was uninterpretable.
span.quote: Thus, neither the control (Vehicle) nor the experimental group (Bupivacaine) showed significant extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: In the second experiment only the group that never underwent surgery showed a reliable drop in place preference, isolating the surgery/injection procedure rather than the drug as the cause.
span.quote: The results of the separate paired t-tests showed a significant decrease in preference for only the No Sx group [ t (11) = 2.5 p < .05].

span.label: Because a no-surgery control that received the same handling did extinguish, the disruption is attributable to the microinjection procedure itself and not to the stress of being handled.
span.quote: Together, these experiments suggest some component of the microinjection procedure (but not merely the handling required to make the injections) interfered with extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: Extending extinction training to six days did not rescue extinction in either injected group, showing the impairment is persistent rather than a matter of insufficient training.
span.quote: Despite doubling the number of extinction trials, we found that both mPFC-injected groups continued to exhibit impaired extinction—that is, both groups showed persistent CPP (data not shown).

span.label: The authors conclude the repeated intra-mPFC microinjection technique, as performed, is unsuitable for studying extinction of ethanol place preference in mice.
span.quote: It is important to note that irrespective of how each component of the microinjection procedure contributes to the observed effect, as currently performed, this procedure is not adequately suited to examine the effects of intra-mPFC pharmacological manipulations on extinction of EtOH-CPP in mice.

span.label: Surgery and anaesthesia alone are ruled out as the cause, since a single electrode insertion at the same coordinates in earlier work left extinction intact.
span.quote: It is unlikely that the observed effect was a direct result of the surgery/anesthesia per se as we have previously shown that a one-time insertion of an electrode into the same area of the mPFC while under general anesthesia did not impair subsequent extinction

span.label: vehicle and bupivacaine groups both failed to extinguish, leaving the drug effect untestable
span.quote: Thus, neither the control (Vehicle) nor the experimental group (Bupivacaine) showed significant extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: in the second experiment only the unoperated group extinguished
span.quote: These data suggest that the No Sx, but not Vehicle or Bupivacaine, group significantly extinguished.

span.label: handling alone does not explain it, since the no-surgery group was handled and still extinguished
span.quote: Together, these experiments suggest some component of the microinjection procedure (but not merely the handling required to make the injections) interfered with extinction of EtOH-CPP.

span.label: the damage was concentrated in cortical layers I-III and, because the cannula was on the midline, affected both hemispheres
span.quote: Post-mortem histological examination suggested that the tissue damage (i.e., cell proliferation) caused by implantation of the cannula, repeated insertion of the injector, and/or injection of solution (vehicle or bupivacaine) is substantial and limited primarily to Layers I-III of the mPFC ( Figure 1B ).

span.label: doubling the extinction training did not rescue it
span.quote: Despite doubling the number of extinction trials, we found that both mPFC-injected groups continued to exhibit impaired extinction—that is, both groups showed persistent CPP (data not shown).

span.label: surgery and anaesthesia were ruled out by a matched earlier study in which a single electrode insertion did not impair extinction
span.quote: It is unlikely that the observed effect was a direct result of the surgery/anesthesia per se as we have previously shown that a one-time insertion of an electrode into the same area of the mPFC while under general anesthesia did not impair subsequent extinction [ 1 ].

span.label: extinction (operational definition used for analysis)
span.quote: Extinction was defined a priori as a significant reduction in place preference that was determined by Bonferroni-adjusted within-subjects comparisons of preferences on Test 1 and 2 (paired t-tests) for each group following an initial 2-way ANOVA (Group × Test) and were performed whether or not the interaction was significant.

span.label: bupivacaine
span.quote: Similar to lidocaine, bupivacaine is a sodium channel blocker that, when injected, temporarily inactivates neuronal signaling by preventing membrane depolarization and subsequent action potentials

span.label: bupivacaine
span.quote: Similar to lidocaine, bupivacaine is a sodium channel blocker that, when injected, temporarily inactivates neuronal signaling by preventing membrane depolarization and subsequent action potentials [ 4 ].

span.label: extinction
span.quote: Extinction was defined a priori as a significant reduction in place preference that was determined by Bonferroni-adjusted within-subjects comparisons of preferences on Test 1 and 2 (paired t-tests) for each group following an initial 2-way ANOVA (Group × Test) and were performed whether or not the interaction was significant.

span.label: substance infused into the mPFC before each extinction trial (bupivacaine versus saline vehicle)
span.term: substance infused into the mPFC before each extinction trial (bupivacaine versus saline vehicle)
span.quote: In the PM sessions, animals received a microinjection of vehicle (saline) or bupivacaine (bupivacaine hydrochloride (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) in isotonic saline at 2% w/v or 20 mg/ml) followed by an IP saline injection and immediate placement onto the CS+ floor for 30 min.

span.label: number of extinction days (three in Experiment 1, four in Experiment 2)
span.term: number of extinction days (three in Experiment 1, four in Experiment 2)
span.quote: Second, extinction was extended by an extra trial for a total of four days of extinction to increase the amount of nonreinforced exposure to the cues in hopes of further reducing the preference in the Vehicle group.

span.label: percentage of the test session spent on the ethanol-paired (CS+) floor
span.term: percentage of the test session spent on the ethanol-paired (CS+) floor
span.quote: place preference was assessed using analysis of variance (ANOVA) of the percentage of each test spent on the EtOH-paired (CS+) floor (% Time on EtOH-paired floor)

span.label: No-Surgery (No Sx) group receiving the handling but no cannula or infusion
span.term: No-Surgery (No Sx) group receiving the handling but no cannula or infusion
span.quote: Finally, an additional control group that did not receive surgery was included (No Sx group) in order to assess the effects of the handling portion of the microinjection procedure on extinction learning.

span.label: histological verification of injector-tip placement between the prelimbic and infralimbic mPFC
span.term: histological verification of injector-tip placement between the prelimbic and infralimbic mPFC
span.quote: Similar to Experiment 1, histological analysis revealed that the injector tracks were aimed between the PL and IL subregions of the mPFC and there was no difference in the location of injector tips for the two groups

span.label: injected compound (bupivacaine, vehicle, or no surgery)
span.term: injected compound (bupivacaine, vehicle, or no surgery)
span.quote: Finally, an additional control group that did not receive surgery was included (No Sx group) in order to assess the effects of the handling portion of the microinjection procedure on extinction learning.

span.label: percent time on the ethanol-paired floor
span.term: percent time on the ethanol-paired floor
span.quote: As described previously [ 1 , 8 ], place preference was assessed using analysis of variance (ANOVA) of the percentage of each test spent on the EtOH-paired (CS+) floor (% Time on EtOH-paired floor).

span.label: number of extinction days
span.quote: Second, extinction was extended by an extra trial for a total of four days of extinction to increase the amount of nonreinforced exposure to the cues in hopes of further reducing the preference in the Vehicle group.

span.label: timing of surgery relative to conditioning
span.term: timing of surgery relative to conditioning
span.quote: First, cannula implantation surgery was performed prior to conditioning.

span.label: injector tip location
span.quote: Histological analysis revealed that the injector tracks terminated at a point within the target region between the PL and IL subregions of the mPFC and there was no difference in the location of injector tips for the two groups ( Figure 1 ).

span.label: n=108 — total number of adult male DBA/2J mice used across the experiments
span.quote: Adult, male DBA/2J mice (n=108) were obtained from Jackson Laboratory (Sacramento, CA) at 6–7 weeks old and allowed to acclimate to the animal colony for 2 or 3 weeks before experiments commenced.

span.label: F (1,33) = 4.3, p < .05 — main effect of Test on percent time on the ethanol-paired floor in Experiment 1
span.quote: Specifically, the 2-way ANOVA of the Percent Time Spent on the EtOH-paired floor revealed a main effect of Test [ F (1,33) = 4.3, p < .05] but no main effect of Group or a Group × Test interaction ( p's > .05).

span.label: F (1,40) = 9.3, p < .005 — main effect of Test on place preference in Experiment 2
span.quote: Specifically, the initial 2-way ANOVA revealed a main effect of Test [ F (1,40) = 9.3, p < .005] but not Group, and no significant Group × Test interaction ( p's > .05).

span.label: t (11) = 2.5 p < .05 — the only significant within-group preference reduction, found in the No-Surgery group
span.quote: The results of the separate paired t-tests showed a significant decrease in preference for only the No Sx group [ t (11) = 2.5 p < .05].

span.label: 18 — animals excluded from Experiment 1, split between failure to show preference and failed histology
span.quote: In Experiment 1, a total of 18 animals were removed from analysis (9 showed less than 50% preference on Test 1 and an additional 9 were removed for not meeting histological criteria).

span.label: less than 25% — share of subjects that failed to acquire a place preference after two conditioning trials
span.quote: These experiments revealed that less than 25% of all subjects failed to express significant preference following the 2-trial conditioning procedure

span.label: .05 — the alpha level adopted for all statistical tests
span.quote: Overall α was set at .05 for all statistical tests.

span.label: 0.2 μL over 2 min (0.1 μL/min) — volume and rate of each intra-mPFC infusion of vehicle or bupivacaine
span.quote: A syringe pump (Model A-74900-10, Cole Parmer, Vernon Hills, IL) delivered 0.2 μL of vehicle or bupivacaine over 2 min (0.1 μL/min) and injectors remained in place for 30 sec after the injection was complete in order to prevent diffusion up the cannula.

span.label: n=108 — total mice across both experiments before exclusions
span.quote: Adult, male DBA/2J mice (n=108) were obtained from Jackson Laboratory (Sacramento, CA) at 6–7 weeks old and allowed to acclimate to the animal colony for 2 or 3 weeks before experiments commenced.

span.label: 18 animals removed — exclusions in Experiment 1 - nine non-learners and nine on histology
span.quote: In Experiment 1, a total of 18 animals were removed from analysis (9 showed less than 50% preference on Test 1 and an additional 9 were removed for not meeting histological criteria).

span.label: 16 animals removed — the equivalent in Experiment 2
span.quote: In Experiment 2, a total of 16 animals were removed from the analysis (8 showed less than 50% preference on Test 1 and an additional 8 were removed for not meeting histological criteria).

span.label: 0.2 μL over 2 min — the injection volume and rate, chosen to inactivate most of the target subregions
span.quote: A syringe pump (Model A-74900-10, Cole Parmer, Vernon Hills, IL) delivered 0.2 μL of vehicle or bupivacaine over 2 min (0.1 μL/min) and injectors remained in place for 30 sec after the injection was complete in order to prevent diffusion up the cannula.

span.label: >90% of neuronal activation — the intended coverage of the inactivation, from prior diffusion studies
span.quote: Based on previous parametric studies of effective diffusion, this injection volume of bupivacaine was expected to prevent >90% of neuronal activation within the PL and IL subregions of the mPFC [ 9 ] for up 90 min [ 10 ].

span.label: 2 g/kg — the ethanol dose paired with the floor cue
span.quote: Briefly, on the first day, mice were given a saline injection (12.5 ml/kg) and habituated to the conditioning apparatus, equipped with white paper flooring, for 5 min.

p.note: The full text of this article is not redistributable, so it is not included here. Every tag above carries the exact sentence it was made from, quoted under fair quotation. The article itself is at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bbr.2012.01.059.
